description: POST /v2/databases/{uuid}/dbs answers 422 `database name is not available` for a moment after a new MySQL cluster comes online, then accepts the same name. Type it as DatabaseNameNotAvailable so a create can retry it; other 422s stay UnprocessableEntity.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The database name can't be used right now (422 `database name is not available`), as on a MySQL cluster that just came online.
